en.bdb: Living up to one's natural repute

verses.gurmukhi: ਚੰਦਨ ਵਾਸ ਵਣਾਸਪਤਿ ਸਭ ਚੰਦਨ ਹੋਵੈ।
verses.translit_en: cha(n)dhan vaas vanaasapat sabh cha(n)dhan hovai|

en.bdb: The whole vegetation planted near sandal tree becomes fragrant like sandal.

verses.gurmukhi: ਅਸਟ ਧਾਤੁ ਇਕ ਧਾਤੁ ਹੋਇ ਸੰਗਿ ਪਾਰਸਿ ਢੋਵੈ।
verses.translit_en: asaT dhaat ik dhaat hoi sa(n)g paaras ddovai|

en.bdb: Being in touch with the philosophers’s stone and the alloy of light metals transforms into one metal (gold).

verses.gurmukhi: ਨਦੀਆ ਨਾਲੇ ਵਾਹੜੈ ਮਿਲਿ ਗੰਗ ਗੰਗੋਵੈ।
verses.translit_en: nadheeaa naale vaahaRai mil ga(n)g ga(n)govai|

en.bdb: Rivers, streams and brooks after joining the Ganges are known by the name of Ganges.

verses.gurmukhi: ਪਤਿਤ ਉਧਾਰਣੁ ਸਾਧਸੰਗੁ ਪਾਪਾਂ ਮਲੁ ਧੋਵੈ।
verses.translit_en: patit udhaaran saadhasa(n)g paapaa(n) mal dhovai|

en.bdb: The redeemer of the fallen ones is the holy congregation wherein the dirt of sins is cleansed.

verses.gurmukhi: ਨਰਕ ਨਿਵਾਰ ਅਸੰਖ ਹੋਇ ਲਖ ਪਤਿਤ ਸੰਗੋਵੈ।
verses.translit_en: narak nivaar asa(n)kh hoi lakh patit sa(n)govai|

en.bdb: Myriads of apostates and hells have obtained redemption through and in the holy congregation.
The gurmukh beholds and understands that God pervades one and all.
